feeds.title: The Tarot Lady
feeds.description: Theresa Reed have been reading professionally for over 25 years, combining the use of Tarot Cards, Astrology, and other forms of divination to help her clients improve their lives and find their direction. Her intention is to empower you with clear and gentle guidance on your spiritual journey.

feeds.title: Little Red Tarot
feeds.description: Little Red Tarot is an alternative tarot resource for anyone who's curious about what a deck of 78 cards can teach them. This blog covers topics from tarot tips and ideas to social justice, radical healing to personal journeys with tarot cards, and more.

feeds.title: Michele Knight
feeds.description: Articles archives from award-winning TV psychic Michele Knight and her professional psychic readers.

feeds.title: Benebell Wen
feeds.description: Benebell Wen is an Author and also an Independent Metaphysician. This is her website on her metaphysical interests. She don't take divination, craft, or any of the work she does in the esoteric lightly. For her, strict compliance to ethics isn't a matter of professional code or integrity; it's a matter of my own fate and personal karma.

feeds.title: Ethony
feeds.description: Ethony is the Headmistress at the Tarot Readers Academy, mistress at the Tarot Readers Academy, Tarot Reader and Adept, Modern Witch, Author, Artist and Teacher. She adore aiding Awakened Souls around the world with the Tarot, Oracle cards, magic and spiritual tools. She believes that magic is everywhere and that our lives can be truly enchanted if we are open and awakened.

feeds.title: Carrie Mallon
feeds.description: Carrie is a proponent of creative living & a tarot reader. She is reeling in wisdom from the sea of tarot. She uses use tarot to inspire you as you navigate your own journey.

feeds.title: Traditional Tarot
feeds.description: Discover a treasure trove of French-language Tarot materials translated into English. Uncover overlooked and influential books, articles, and more, providing profound insights into Tarot's history, symbolism, and potential. Gain a deeper understanding of the Tarot and its possibilities through digests, reviews, and critiques. Expand your knowledge and open up new horizons in the world of Tarot.

feeds.title: Melissa Cynova Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Melissa Cynova. I've been reading tarot cards for 30 years and I can tell you that they're not magical, mystical, or otherwise. Tarot is a journey that we take together. Just the two of us. You lead the way, and I'll point out the trouble spots or the things you might miss if you're looking in the wrong direction. Through this blog, I share weekly content on the cards, on finding happiness, and on life.

feeds.title: Daily Tarot Girl
feeds.description: In this blog Kate shares her knowledge of Tarot card reading and also inspires you to use your Tarot cards for personal growth and connecting with the Divine. Kate is an Intuitive Tarot Card Reader/Teacher, Writer, Dancer and Fitness/Life Coach. She adore Tarot, oracle cards and all things metaphysical.

feeds.title: Chhavi Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Chhavi founded the Chhavi Tarot, a platform to provide Tarot consultation, Guidance, and Healing solutions, as a result of her passion for and belief in the Tarot as a means of discovering strategies for making positive changes in life and as a manifestation of self aspirations for an ideal future. She wants to help people reach their full potential by providing guidance that is solution-focused and efficient physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual healing. The blog includes weekly forecasts, predictions, and horoscopes for each sun sign and zodiac.

feeds.title: Sasha Graham Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Learn everything tarot with the author, speaker, and tarot teacher, Sasha Graham. Author Sasha Graham writes about tarot as it relates to love, relationships, lifestyle, career, travel, family, yoga, divination, meditation, self-knowledge, and spirituality. Follow to read about her adventures around the world, tarot tips, and valuable insights about the Dark Wood Tarot.

feeds.title: Sea Tarot
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Sea Tarot. My name is Meredyth. I am truly grateful to introduce myself and the practice of Sea Tarot. I am a professional Tarot reader based in San Francisco serving clients everywhere. Get modern Tarot Readings from an intuitive guide that help support both life's challenges, and opportunities.

feeds.title: Tarot by Hilary Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Hilary Parry Haggerty, and I'm a tarot reader, witch, writer, editor, and teacher. I started reading tarot at sixteen years old, after gifting my mum a tarot deck that was not-so-well received. I got that tarot deck back in the form of 'Hilary, just read the cards for me' and a tarot reader was born. If you're looking for someone headed to read your cards (or teach you), I'd love to work with you.

feeds.title: Starcana Cosmic Forecast
feeds.description: Life guidance, intuitive psychic readings, and advice with Suzi Dronzek. Intuitive psychic readings with a spiritual astrology tarot blog for insight and direction.

feeds.title: Tarot Thrones

Since 2012 I've been writing almost exclusively about the Page, Knight, Queen, and King cards (and all the other variations in between!) and have hundreds of Court Card blog posts for you to read so that you can become an expert in the Tarot's court cards!

feeds.title: TABI Blog
feeds.description: A blog about tarot reading and tarot cards and deck by TABI (Tarot Association of the British Isles).

The deck of 78 cards represents the true essence of the Tarot: spiritual enlightenment, transformation, and discovery as humanity expands into new dimensions.

feeds.title: Maddy Elruna Blog
feeds.description: Maddy have been a tarot card reader for more than 20 years, and she can help you find the answers and direction that you need in life through a reading of the cards. A tarot reading with her helps you to decide which is the most suitable way forward for you, offering your guidance as you make a choice between possibilities.

feeds.title: Mister Tarot Blog
